reason: The cited evidence (E1) shows Hf segregation to grain boundaries in a related RHEA and its effect on hardness, but it does not provide any data on the inhibition of Cr/V-rich precipitates, which is the central mechanism of the hypothesis. The key premise that Hf segregation prevents precipitation is unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: Hf segregates to grain boundaries in a similar RHEA system
Hf segregation increases hardness by ~3 GPa upon annealing
The RHEA shows high irradiation resistance and no dislocation loops
Irradiation further increases hardness by 3.75 GPa
Hf segregation can inhibit Cr/V-rich precipitate nucleation and growth
